raw_text: As protests against the NRC supplementary exclusion list intensify across Assam's Barak Valley, the district administration has shut down internet services in Silchar, Karimganj, and Hailakandi. Schools and colleges have been closed indefinitely. The All Assam Bengali Youth Federation has submitted a memorandum to the Governor demanding immediate withdrawal of the list.
clean_text: Internet shut down in Silchar, Karimganj, and Hailakandi as NRC protests intensify. Schools closed. Bengali Youth Federation submits memorandum to Governor.
